name: Synapse Layer
description: Zero-knowledge memory layer for AI agents with differential privacy and AES-256 encryption.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant persisted memory using semantic, temporal, priority, or hybrid routing. Governance: requires reason (10–200 chars). Rate limit: 20/min.

query.description: What to recall — natural language query for memory retrieval.

reason.description: REQUIRED (10–200 chars). Audit policy: MEMORY_EXPORT_GOVERNANCE_V1. Human-readable justification for retrieving PLAINTEXT memory. Without this parameter the call WILL fail with code -32602. Example: "User asked me to summarize last week decisions."

scope.description: Explicit memory scope. "agent" (default, fail-closed) = limits recall to the given agent_id (or the token agent). "tenant" = cross-agent recall within the authenticated tenant. If omitted with agent_id present, "agent" is inferred; if both omitted, the token agent is used (verified-token scope).

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (canonical or alias). Used only when scope="agent" or scope is inferred.

mode.description: Recall routing mode. "temporal" = pure chronological, "semantic" = FTS + TQ ranking, "priority" = critical/high-TQ first, "hybrid" = weighted blend, "auto" = detect from query (default).

tools.name: save_to_synapse
tools.description: Persist memory with encryption at rest, sanitization, and deduplication controls.

content.description: The memory content to store securely.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier for memory isolation. Defaults to "default".

tools.name: process_text
tools.description: Extract candidate memories from free-form text with governance filters and sanitization.

text.description: Free-form text to scan for auto-save triggers.

project.description: Force a specific project (e.g., SYNAPSE_LAYER, OFFLY). Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search persisted memory across agent scopes using full-text matching.

query.description: Search query — natural language or keywords.

scope.description: Explicit search scope. "agent" (default, fail-closed) = limits search to the given agent_id (or the token agent). "tenant" = cross-agent search within the authenticated tenant. If omitted with agent_id present, "agent" is inferred; if both omitted, the token agent is used (verified-token scope).

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (canonical or alias). Used only when scope="agent" or scope is inferred.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check service availability, engine version, and storage health. Public method.

tools.name: initialize_context
tools.description: Initialize a persistent memory context for a conversation or agent session.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a memory entry to the persistent store. Alias of save_to_synapse.

content.description: The memory content to store securely.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store structured memory with metadata and trust scoring.

content.description: The memory content to store securely.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier for memory isolation. Defaults to "default".

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Recall persisted memory by query. Alias of recall.

query.description: What to recall — natural language query for memory retrieval.

reason.description: REQUIRED (10–200 chars). Audit policy: MEMORY_EXPORT_GOVERNANCE_V1. Without this the call WILL fail with code -32602. Example: "Checking user project status."

scope.description: Explicit memory scope. "agent" (default, fail-closed) = limits recall to the given agent_id (or the token agent). "tenant" = cross-agent recall within the authenticated tenant. If omitted with agent_id present, "agent" is inferred; if both omitted, the token agent is used (verified-token scope).

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (canonical or alias). Used only when scope="agent" or scope is inferred.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List memory metadata with pagination and governance limits.

scope.description: Explicit memory scope. "agent" (default, fail-closed) = lists memories for the given agent_id (or the token agent). "tenant" = lists memories across all agents of the authenticated tenant.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (canonical or alias). Used only when scope="agent" or scope is inferred.

limit.description: Maximum memory metadata rows to return. Hard-capped: default 5, max 10. Values above 10 are silently reduced to 10.

tools.name: memory_feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback to adjust trust scoring for stored memories.

memoryId.description: ID of the memory to provide feedback on.

signal.description: Feedback signal: used (auto), helpful (positive), irrelevant (negative), ignored.

tools.name: neural_handover
tools.description: Transfer contextual state between agents with continuity controls.

token.description: The handover token (64 hex chars). Generated by the source agent/user in Forge UI.

reason.description: REQUIRED (10–200 chars). Human-readable justification for consuming this handover. Example: "Receiving project context from Claude session."

consuming_agent.description: Agent identifier consuming the handover (defaults to token agent).

tools.name: slo_report
tools.description: Return uptime and SLO metrics for the MCP service.

admin_token.description: Admin authentication token. Must match ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable.

window_hours.description: Time windows in hours for the report. Default: [24, 168] (24h + 7d).
